title: The Circumference of a Radius-10 Circle
description: Using pi to find the circumference of a circle with radius 10.
narration_lines: What's the circumference of a circle with radius 10?
Picture the radius wrapping around the circle's edge.
It takes about two times pi, around 6.28, of those radius-lengths to go all the way around.
So the circumference is about 63 units -- pi is just how many radiuses wrap around, doubled.

params.hook: Circumference of a circle with radius 10?
params.footnote: pi (≈3.14) is just how many "radiuses" wrap around, doubled
